definitions: Cystic fibrosis, a hereditary disease affecting the exocrine glands, causing the production of abnormally thick mucus, leading to the blockage of the pancreatic ducts, intestines, and bronchi and often resulting in respiratory infection.
Credit default swap, a financial swap agreement that the seller of the CDS will compensate the buyer in the event of a loan default or other credit event.
Combat footage, video or photographic material recorded during military combat operations.
examples: Many patients with CF require extensive medical care.
The bank used a CF to hedge against potential losses.
The documentary included raw CF from the front lines.
